text: A year later he had several hundred scholars executed, and when his own son Fusu spoke up for them, he sent him north to the Wall.
spoken: A year later he had several hundred scholars executed. And when his own son Foo-soo spoke up for them, he sent him north, to the Wall.
whisper: A year later, he had several hundred scholars executed, and when his own son Fusso spoke up for them, he sent him north to the Wall.
